claim.claim-text: 1. A system for recording and/or validating use of an electric vehicle rechargeable battery in an energy network, the system comprising:

a plurality of geographically distributed metered charging points in a local environment of the energy network; and a plurality of mobile electric vehicles having rechargeable batteries and having associated logic incorporated in the batteries or in electric vehicles, wherein the electric vehicles are chargeable via the charging points, wherein the charging points and logic associated with the batteries are arranged to store local ledgers and are further arranged to detect a charging event associated with a rechargeable battery being connected to a charging point for metered charging or discharging, and in response to detecting a charging event, form a hash value of the event details from a credential associated with the rechargeable battery and a credential associated with the charging point; and append the hash value and a timestamp of the event to both ledgers to form cryptographically linked chain of events at both the charging point and battery logic.

2. The system of claim 1, arranged to verify a charging event by checking the integrity of a chain and or by checking a charging event seen in a ledger at a battery has a matching entry in the ledger at the indicated charging point with a matching time stamp.

3. The system of claim 1 or claim 2, comprising a key server arranged to issue shared keys in a public-private key system for authorised charging points and electric vehicle, wherein the signatures are generated using the keys.
4. The system of claim 3, wherein the Distribution Network Operator or Distribution System Operator for the local environment acts as key server.

5. A method of recording energy charging events in a mesh-chain in a system comprising a plurality of geographically distributed, metered charging points and a plurality of rechargeable batteries having associated logic incorporated in the batteries or in mobile devices incorporating the batteries, the method comprising:
6. A method according to claim 5, wherein the credentials are shared public and private key between the charging point and the battery .
7. A method according to claim 5 or claim 6, wherein the hash comprises a cryptographic hash of the previous event in the ledger to form a cryptographically linked chain of events at each node.
8. A method according to any of claims 5 to 7, wherein the hash includes a local geolocational reference.

9. A method according to any of claims 5 to 8, wherein the geolocational reference comprise a measured Wi-Fi signal identifier, identifier from a cell phone tower, GPS signal, or signature locally incorporated into a powerline transmission.
10. A method according to any of claims 5 to 9, wherein the rechargeable batteries are comprised in electric vehicles.

11. A method according to any of claims 5 to 10, the method comprising accounting of use of the battery, or monetization of power received or delivered by the battery, or sharing assets in a peer to peer model.

12. A method according to any of claims 5 to 11, the method comprising checking authenticity of an event by checking the integrity of a chain and or by checking a charging event seen in a ledger at a battery has a matching entry in the ledger at the indicated charging point with a matching time stamp.
